title: The LLM Data Auditor: A Metric-oriented Survey on Quality and Trustworthiness in Evaluating Synthetic Data
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey on the evaluation of synthetic data generated by LLMs. It focuses on technical metrics for quality (validity, fidelity, diversity, utility) and trustworthiness (fairness, robustness, safety, privacy, faithfulness). While it discusses 'safety' and 'fairness' as pillars of trustworthiness, it does not specifically evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks beyond standard AI safety benchmarks.
